# google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item

An evaluation item represents a single prompt and optional model/candidate responses,
ground truth, and rubrics for evaluation in Vertex AI.


To get more information about EvaluationItem, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.evaluationItems)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/models/evaluation-overview)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Evaluation Item


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item" "evaluation_item" {
  region               = "us-central1"
  display_name         = "eval-item"
  evaluation_item_type = "REQUEST"

  labels = {
    env  = "test"
    team = "evaluation"
  }

  metadata = jsonencode({
    author  = "terraform-test"
    version = "1.0"
  })

  evaluation_request {
    prompt {
      text = "What is the capital of France?"
    }
    golden_response {
      candidate = "ground-truth"
      text      = "Paris"
    }
    candidate_responses {
      candidate = "model-a"
      text      = "Paris"
    }
    candidate_responses {
      candidate = "model-b"
      value = jsonencode({
        response = "Paris"
      })
    }
    candidate_responses {
      candidate = "model-c"
      agent_data = jsonencode({
        agents = {
          agent_1 = {
            agentId     = "agent_1"
            agentType   = "LlmAgent"
            description = "Assistant"
            instruction = "Be helpful"
          }
        }
      })
    }
    rubrics {
      name         = "test_rubric_group"
      group_id     = "test_rubric_group_id"
      display_name = "Test Rubric Group"
      rubrics {
        rubric_id  = "test_rubric_1"
        type       = "SUMMARIZATION_QUALITY"
        importance = "HIGH"
        content {
          property {
            description = "The model response is concise and accurate."
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Evaluation Item Gcs


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "eval-item-bucket"
  location                    = "us-central1"
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
  force_destroy               = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "viewer" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-aiplatform.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "object" {
  name   = "eval_request.json"
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  content = jsonencode({
    prompt = {
      text = "What is the capital of France?"
    }
  })
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item" "evaluation_item_gcs" {
  region               = "us-central1"
  display_name         = "eval-item"
  evaluation_item_type = "REQUEST"
  gcs_uri              = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.object.name}"

  depends_on = [
    google_storage_bucket_iam_member.viewer,
    google_storage_bucket_object.object,
  ]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  The user-friendly display name for the EvaluationItem.

* `evaluation_item_type` -
  (Required)
  The type of the EvaluationItem.
  Possible values are: `REQUEST`, `RESULT`.

* `region` -
  (Required)
  The region of the EvaluationItem. eg us-central1


* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  Labels for the EvaluationItem.

  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `metadata` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined metadata for this evaluation item as a JSON string.

* `gcs_uri` -
  (Optional)
  The Cloud Storage object where the request or response is stored.
  Exactly one of `evaluation_request` or `gcs_uri` can be set.

* `evaluation_request` -
  (Optional)
  The request to evaluate.
  Exactly one of `evaluation_request` or `gcs_uri` can be set.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_evaluation_request"></a>The `evaluation_request` block supports:

* `prompt` -
  (Optional)
  The request/prompt to evaluate.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_prompt).

* `golden_response` -
  (Optional)
  The ideal response or ground truth.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_golden_response).

* `candidate_responses` -
  (Optional)
  Responses from model under test and other baseline models for comparison.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_candidate_responses).

* `rubrics` -
  (Optional)
  Named groups of rubrics associated with this prompt.
  The key is a user-defined name for the rubric group.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_rubrics).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_prompt"></a>The `prompt` block supports:

* `text` -
  (Optional)
  Text prompt.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, `prompt_template_data`, `agent_data`, or `user_scenario` can be set.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  Fields and values that can be used to populate the prompt template, as a JSON string.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, `prompt_template_data`, `agent_data`, or `user_scenario` can be set.

* `prompt_template_data` -
  (Optional)
  Prompt template data.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, `prompt_template_data`, `agent_data`, or `user_scenario` can be set.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_prompt_prompt_template_data).

* `agent_data` -
  (Optional)
  Represents the complete execution trace of a multi-turn conversation,
  which can involve single or multiple agents, as a JSON string. This
  serves as the input context for agent scraping.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, `prompt_template_data`, `agent_data`, or `user_scenario` can be set.

* `user_scenario` -
  (Optional)
  The generated user scenario used to drive multi-turn agent running results.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, `prompt_template_data`, `agent_data`, or `user_scenario` can be set.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_prompt_user_scenario).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_prompt_prompt_template_data"></a>The `prompt_template_data` block supports:

* `values` -
  (Optional)
  The values for fields in the prompt template, as a JSON string mapping
  field names to Content objects.

<a name="nested_evaluation_request_prompt_user_scenario"></a>The `user_scenario` block supports:

* `starting_prompt` -
  (Required)
  The prompt that starts the conversation between the simulated user and
  the agent under test.

* `conversation_plan` -
  (Required)
  The plan for the conversation, used to drive the multi-turn agent run and
  generate the simulated agent evaluation dataset.

<a name="nested_evaluation_request_golden_response"></a>The `golden_response` block supports:

* `candidate` -
  (Required)
  The name of the candidate that produced the response.

* `text` -
  (Optional)
  Text response.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, or `agent_data` can be set.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  Fields and values that can be used to populate the response template, as a JSON string.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, or `agent_data` can be set.

* `agent_data` -
  (Optional)
  Represents the complete execution trace of a multi-turn conversation,
  which can involve single or multiple agents, as a JSON string. This
  field is used to provide the full output of an agent's run, including
  all turns and events, for direct evaluation.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, or `agent_data` can be set.

* `error` -
  (Output)
  Error while scraping model or agent.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_golden_response_error).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_golden_response_error"></a>The `error` block contains:

* `code` -
  (Output)
  The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

* `message` -
  (Output)
  A developer-facing error message.

<a name="nested_evaluation_request_candidate_responses"></a>The `candidate_responses` block supports:

* `candidate` -
  (Required)
  The name of the candidate that produced the response.

* `text` -
  (Optional)
  Text response.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, or `agent_data` can be set.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  Fields and values that can be used to populate the response template, as a JSON string.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, or `agent_data` can be set.

* `agent_data` -
  (Optional)
  Represents the complete execution trace of a multi-turn conversation,
  which can involve single or multiple agents, as a JSON string. This
  field is used to provide the full output of an agent's run, including
  all turns and events, for direct evaluation.
  At most one of `text`, `value`, or `agent_data` can be set.

* `error` -
  (Output)
  Error while scraping model or agent.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_candidate_responses_error).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_candidate_responses_error"></a>The `error` block contains:

* `code` -
  (Output)
  The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

* `message` -
  (Output)
  A developer-facing error message.

<a name="nested_evaluation_request_rubrics"></a>The `rubrics` block supports:

* `name` - (Required) The identifier for this object. Format specified above.

* `group_id` -
  (Optional)
  Unique identifier for the group.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Human-readable name for the group.

* `rubrics` -
  (Optional)
  Rubrics that are part of this group.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_rubrics_rubrics).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_rubrics_rubrics"></a>The `rubrics` block supports:

* `rubric_id` -
  (Optional)
  Unique identifier for the rubric.

* `type` -
  (Optional)
  A type designator for the rubric, e.g. `SUMMARIZATION_QUALITY`.

* `importance` -
  (Optional)
  The relative importance of this rubric.
  Possible values are: `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`.

* `content` -
  (Required)
  The actual testable criteria for the rubric.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_rubrics_rubrics_content).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_rubrics_rubrics_content"></a>The `content` block supports:

* `property` -
  (Optional)
  Evaluation criteria based on a specific property.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_request_rubrics_rubrics_content_property).


<a name="nested_evaluation_request_rubrics_rubrics_content_property"></a>The `property` block supports:

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the property being evaluated.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationItems/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The short name of the EvaluationItem (the final component of the resource name).

* `evaluation_response` -
  The response from evaluation.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_response).

* `error` -
  The error that occurred during the evaluation item processing.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_error).

* `create_time` -
  Timestamp when this EvaluationItem was created.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.


<a name="nested_evaluation_response"></a>The `evaluation_response` block contains:

* `evaluation_request` -
  (Output)
  The request item that was evaluated. Format:
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/evaluationItems/{evaluation_item}`

* `evaluation_run` -
  (Output)
  The evaluation run that was used to generate the result. Format:
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/evaluationRuns/{evaluation_run}`

* `metric` -
  (Output)
  The metric that was evaluated.

* `metadata` -
  (Output)
  Metadata about the evaluation result, as a JSON string.

* `request` -
  (Output)
  The request that was evaluated, as a JSON string.

* `candidate_results` -
  (Output)
  The results for the metric.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_response_candidate_results).


<a name="nested_evaluation_response_candidate_results"></a>The `candidate_results` block contains:

* `candidate` -
  (Output)
  The candidate that is being evaluated.

* `metric` -
  (Output)
  The metric that was evaluated.

* `score` -
  (Output)
  The score for the metric.

* `explanation` -
  (Output)
  The explanation for the metric.

* `additional_results` -
  (Output)
  Additional results for the metric, as a JSON string.

* `error` -
  (Output)
  Error while evaluating the candidate for the metric.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_response_candidate_results_error).

* `rubric_verdicts` -
  (Output)
  The rubric verdicts for the metric.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_evaluation_response_candidate_results_rubric_verdicts).


<a name="nested_evaluation_response_candidate_results_error"></a>The `error` block contains:

* `code` -
  (Output)
  The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

* `message` -
  (Output)
  A developer-facing error message.

<a name="nested_evaluation_response_candidate_results_rubric_verdicts"></a>The `rubric_verdicts` block contains:

* `verdict` -
  (Output)
  Outcome of the evaluation against the rubric.

* `reasoning` -
  (Output)
  Human-readable reasoning for the verdict.

* `evaluated_rubric` -
  (Output)
  The full rubric definition that was evaluated, as a JSON string.

<a name="nested_error"></a>The `error` block contains:

* `code` -
  (Output)
  The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

* `message` -
  (Output)
  A developer-facing error message.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 0 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


EvaluationItem can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationItems/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import EvaluationItem using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import EvaluationItem using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationItems/{{name}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), EvaluationItem can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationItems/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.default {{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.default {{name}}
```
